areaEffects.title: Area Effects
areaEffects.instantHint: Places a one-shot area: every matching token inside is auto-targeted and receives all listed effects immediately, then the area is removed.
areaEffects.behaviorHint: Applies the configured spell effects to tokens inside this area and removes them when they leave (depending on the chosen mode).
areaEffects.keybindHint: Reopens the Persistent Area Effects window if it was closed.
areaEffects.name: Name (optional)
areaEffects.modeInside: While inside (apply on entry, remove on leaving)
areaEffects.modeHint: While inside: effects are re-applied on entry and taken back when the token leaves. Once: effects are applied on entry and left to expire on their own.
areaEffects.durationHint: How many combat rounds the area lasts before it expires. 0 = unlimited (no expiry tracking).
areaEffects.trackCaster: Caster's turns (expires after N of that actor's turns)
areaEffects.trackModeHint: Combat: counts down once per combat round. Caster: assumes the actor whose turn it is when you place it cast the area, and counts down each time that actor's turn starts.
areaEffects.terrainHint: Makes the area difficult terrain (each square costs 10 ft of movement on the ruler) or greater difficult (15 ft). Flying creatures are unaffected.
areaEffects.expired: The "{name}" area expired (its duration ran out).
areaEffects.placeHint: Press Place, then click the map to drop the area (drag-draw direction is available for cones; mouse-wheel rotates).
areaEffects.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? All of its applied effects will be removed from tokens inside it.
areaEffects.privateLabel: Private (only you and the GM see it in this window)
areaEffects.privateHint: The area still appears on the scene; only its entry in this window is hidden from others.
areaEffects.gmOnlyHint: Players cannot see this area on the scene, but its effects still apply to them. Toggle it on or off at any time.
areaEffects.notifyNotOwner: You can only manage areas you created.

areaEffects.notifyNoGmPlace: No GM is connected, so the area could not be placed.
areaEffects.notifyPlaceFail: The area could not be placed. Check the console (F12) for details.

enabled.name: Enable Auto-Decrease Frightened at Turn End
enabled.hint: When a combatant's turn ends, their Frightened value decreases by 1 automatically (the condition is removed at 0), as the rules text promises. Feats that reduce Frightened faster (Dwarven Doughtiness, Calm and Centered) decrease it by 2. Applied by the GM's client for every combatant, including player characters.

enabled.name: Enable Dying & Wounded Automation
enabled.hint: Player characters only. When a PC's HP drops from above 0 to exactly 0 from damage, they gain Dying 1 (Dying 2 if the dropping blow was a critical hit) plus their current Wounded value. When HP is healed back above 0, any Dying still present is removed (manual stabilization to Dying 0 is left alone), and every time the Dying condition is lost, Wounded 1 is gained or increased by 1. Damage taken while already dying and recovery checks stay manual. If the change was caused by a user who doesn't own the target (another player's heal or AoE), a connected GM applies it over the module socket.

enabled.name: Enable Shattering Gem Effect Link
enabled.hint: Adds a quick link to the module's 'Spell Effect: Shattering Gem' tracking effect to every copy of the Shattering Gem spell, right before its Heightened section. The GM's client patches spells already on actors; newly created copies are patched as they are made. Drag the effect from the link onto a creature to track which target the orbiting gem is protecting.

enabled.name: Enable Clear Targets at Turn End
enabled.hint: When a combatant's turn ends, everyone who controlled that combatant automatically loses all their current targets (the GM included), so leftover multi-target selections from AoE spells can't leak into later actions. Targets you set during other actors' turns are kept until your own turn finishes.

enabled.name: Enable Area Effects
enabled.hint: Opens a Persistent Area Effects window (toolbar button or Ctrl+Alt+A) where you choose a template shape and size, then place it on the map like a normal template. The placed area automatically applies the chosen PF2e spell effects to any token inside it.

enabled.name: Enable Feature Hub
enabled.hint: Adds a Hub window (toolbar button or Ctrl+Alt+H) that lists the module's enabled features as buttons, so you can see what is available and open any of them in one click.

enabled.name: Enable Effect Automator
enabled.hint: Automates effect items that roll a saving throw on a trigger (turn start, turn end, or when the actor takes damage) and applies other effects based on the degree of success. Rules are defined and edited in the Effect Automator window (Feature Hub, GM only) and stored as JSON in a world setting.

enabled.name: Enable Action Tracker
enabled.hint: Shows an in-Foundry window while a combat is running with the current combatant's name, the actions they have used this turn. The GM's client automatically counts the current actor's actions from the chat (spell casting times, action/feat costs, weapon Strikes, skill checks, consumable uses, item draws/retrieves/sheathes, reloads, and weapon auxiliary actions like Raise a Shield or Take Cover) and syncs the window to all players. GM-only buttons let you correct the count manually.

actionsPerTurn.name: Actions per Turn
actionsPerTurn.hint: How many actions each combatant is assumed to have per turn. Used only for the 'actions remaining' display.

state.name: Last known state
state.hint: Internal: the GM's last broadcast Action Tracker state, restored when a client joins or reloads mid-combat.

enabled.name: Enable Roll Counter
enabled.hint: Counts every d20 roll made in the world by the player who actually made it (GM rolls included), recorded with its natural result, whether it happened inside a combat, and a timestamp. Open the window with F8: pick a player from the dropdown to see their 1-20 bar chart across five tabs - all d20 rolls, d20 rolls outside combat, d20 rolls during combat, non-d20 dice rolled during combat, and non-d20 dice rolled outside combat. Records are saved automatically and survive reloads.

showClear.name: Show Clear Recorded Rolls button
showClear.hint: Displays a 'Clear All Records' button at the bottom of the Roll Counter window (GM only, with a confirmation dialog). Off by default so records can't be wiped by accident.

state.name: Recorded rolls
state.hint: Internal: the persisted log of every counted roll. Written by the GM's client and restored on reload.

enabled.name: Enable Sustain Reminder
enabled.hint: Reminds players to Sustain their active sustained spells (such as Flaming Sphere or Summon spells) at the start of their turn. Only affects player characters, and only spells whose effect carries the system's origin data (applied via a targeted cast or by dragging the effect from the chat card).

chatMessage.name: Chat Reminder at Turn Start
chatMessage.hint: Posts a message to the chat (visible to everyone) when a player character's turn begins while they have active sustained effects.

trackerBadge.name: Combat Tracker Badge
trackerBadge.hint: Shows a small sustain icon next to combatants in the combat tracker while they have active sustained effects. The GM computes and broadcasts the badge state, so it appears for every player.

patchEffects.name: Auto-enable Sustained Flag on Applied Effects
patchEffects.hint: When an effect for a sustained spell is applied to any actor (dragged from chat or a compendium, or auto-applied), sets the effect's 'Sustained' flag automatically so the reminder can detect it. The system's own effect items (such as Spell Effect: Leaden Steps) are missing this flag; this patches the copies without touching the locked originals.

extraSpells.name: Extra Sustained Spell Names
extraSpells.hint: Comma-separated list of spell names whose effects should also get the Sustained flag, for spells the automatic system scan can't find (homebrew, or non-sustained spells you still want tracked). Example: Calm, My Custom Spell

enabled.name: Enable Improved Invisibility Effects
enabled.hint: Master switch for the improved invisibility features. When off, the 'Enable Player Token Invisibility Toggle' and 'Hide Token on Invisible Condition' options below have no effect.

autoHide.name: Hide Token on Invisible Condition
autoHide.hint: When an actor gains the Invisible condition, hide its tokens (players can no longer see them; the GM still can). Tokens are automatically shown again when the condition ends.

enabled.name: Enable Player Token Invisibility Toggle
enabled.hint: Allows each player to toggle whether their canvas cursor and movement previews are hidden from other players. The GM always sees everything regardless of this toggle.

keybinding.name: Toggle Own Invisibility
keybinding.hint: Hide or show your cursor and token movement previews to other players. Default: F9

hidden.name: Invisible to Others
hidden.hint: Managed automatically by the toggle, keybinding, /toggleinvisibility command, or macro.

enabled.name: Enable Template Effects
enabled.hint: Show a targeting dialog when placing spell area templates and auto-apply the matching spell effect item.

apply.name: Auto-Apply Spell Effects (initial default)
apply.hint: Only used as the initial value of the 'Auto-Apply Spell Effects' checkbox the very first time the dialog is opened. Afterwards the dialog remembers the last value you used.

replaceToolbelt.name: Replace pf2e-toolbelt's Template Helper
replaceToolbelt.hint: Disables the built-in template dialog of the pf2e-toolbelt module so that only this dialog runs. If you ever disable this module, re-enable the pf2e-toolbelt setting there.

enabled.name: Enable Shielded Arm Effect
enabled.hint: Adds a link to the 'Spell Effect: Shielded Arm' compendium item in Shielded Arm spell descriptions and auto-applies it when the spell is cast.

enabled.name: Enable Calm Spell Effect Links
enabled.hint: Adds quick links to the 'Spell Effect: Calm (Minor)' and 'Spell Effect: Calm (Absolute)' compendium items in Calm spell descriptions, so each save-result tier can be applied and tracked.

enabled.name: Enable Spell Shield HP Tracking
enabled.hint: Tracks the HP of spell-effect shields (such as Fire Shield), displays the current HP in the character sheet, lets blocking damage reduce it, and ends the effect when the shield is destroyed.

enabled.name: Enable Direct Attribute Rolls
enabled.hint: Adds a d20 button to each attribute on character sheets. Click to roll that attribute's check (Shift-click for the check dialog with fortune/misfortune and bonuses, Ctrl/Cmd-click for a blind roll when GM).

enabled.name: Popout Initiative Link Sync
enabled.hint: Keeps the initiative roll button instantly in sync on character sheets opened in a popout window, where the PF2e system's own sync is bypassed: enabled as soon as an encounter starts, disabled when it ends, shows 'already rolled' immediately once initiative is rolled, and enables right away when a character is added to an active encounter.

enabled.name: Popout Drag-Drop Repair
enabled.hint: Repairs PF2e inventory drag-and-drop (dragging items into containers/backpacks, reordering) inside popped-out actor sheets. Popping a sheet out makes the PF2e system destroy its sortable instances; this tool re-renders the sheet in the popout window so dragging works again.

enabled.name: Enable Volume Persistence
enabled.hint: Remembers the Music, Environment, and Interface volume sliders from the Playlists sidebar across sessions, even when browser storage is cleared or the server address changes (e.g. rotating Cloudflare tunnel links). Each user keeps their own volumes.

enabled.name: Enable Effect-Apply Animations
enabled.hint: Plays an Automated Animations sequence when a "Spell Effect: <spell>" item lands on an actor. Damaging spells and spells with their own AA menu entry are skipped (AA already animates them); for everything else the spell's description is matched against AA's menus the same way the AAFA module used to (e.g. Leaden Steps plays the Slow animation). Requires the Automated Animations module.

enabled.name: Enable Light Range Tether
enabled.hint: When Spell Effect: Light is on a creature, the GM removes it automatically if that creature (or its caster) moves so the two are farther apart than the spell's range (120 ft). Both tokens must be on the same scene; otherwise the check is skipped. A chat message is posted when the effect expires.

enabled.name: Fix Broken Handlebars Helpers (Parlor compat)
enabled.hint: Restores Foundry's variadic `or`/`and` Handlebars helpers after modules like Parlor overwrite them with 2-argument versions. PF2e's spell card needs `{{or a b c d}}` (4 args) for the Place template button — without this the button never renders.
